changeSet.sql: UPDATE app_user SET created_at = (SELECT MIN(j.created_date) FROM jhi_user j WHERE LOWER(j.email) = LOWER(app_user.email)) WHERE created_at IS NULL

UPDATE app_user SET created_at = CASE WHEN password_linked_at IS NULL THEN google_linked_at WHEN google_linked_at IS NULL OR password_linked_at <= google_linked_at THEN password_linked_at ELSE google_linked_at END WHERE created_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET created_at = terms_accepted_at WHERE created_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE created_at IS NULL
